svg.title: Repositioning Land Into RV and Energy Uses
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-alt-use-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Repositioning Land Into RV and Energy Uses; subtitle: Zoning, layout, lease terms, and cap-rate underwriting in sequence; caption: Operators clear zoning first, model site conversion, underwrite only lease payments on energy deals, and buy RV parks at high caps they can push lower with occupancy.; assumptions note: Week labels sequence the reported operator gates for planning only; no practitioner reported a four-week timeline.; note: Attributed to Heather Blankenship (FY9TF9ZkLwk), The Owner's Math (xjNh4eemKCs), Dan of LandApp by LandGate (Uaymin1wo40), and Dr. Jeff Anzalone (tZwHEMuaXiQ, 5o06VeN0Gak).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Clear Zoning and Permitting; deliverable: Written zoning and permit path for the intended use; gate: No build until cleared; one Blankenship student was shut down for 6-plus months on glamping units.; week: Week 2; title: Model Site Conversion; deliverable: Layout showing usable share of the parcel; gate: 55 to 65% usable on a good layout versus 40% on a poor one; the same 5-acre build swings from about 12% to about 1% cash-on-cash.; week: Week 3; title: Underwrite the Energy Lease; deliverable: Lease model on payments only, matched to optioned acreage; gate: Solar at $300-$2,000 per acre per year with a 2% escalator after a 4-5 year option; storage sites bought at $30,000 per acre.; week: Week 4; title: Underwrite the RV Park Cap Rate; deliverable: Entry cap and occupancy demand plan; gate: Buy at 9-11+ caps versus 3-4 on apartments; Anzalone lifted a 200-site park from 50% to 90% by targeting a nearby employer.
